description: Simulate / backtest a pump.fun sniper or trading bot BEFORE risking SOL: replays its settings on real recent pump.fun launches (fees, priority fee and price impact included, pessimistic fills) and returns what 3 SOL would have become with 0.1 SOL per trade and 30 trades a day: median final balance, share of replays that ran out of SOL and after how many days, result per trade, share of winning trades, plus the median real result of bots that buy as fast, and a link to the interactive chart where any amount can be tried. Use it when someone asks whether a bot strategy or settings (entry delay, take profit, stop loss, holding time, filters) would make money. Past data, not a forecast, not advice.

buys.description: 'trending' = only tokens already up 2x when it buys (default), 'all' = every new token

entry.description: how fast the bot buys after launch: block, 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1m, 2m or 5m (default 2m)

max_hold_seconds.description: sell anyway after this many seconds (grid 10, 60, 300, 1800, 3600, 21600; default 300)

skip_prepared.description: skip launches with 3+ buyers in the launch block

skip_serial_creators.description: skip creators with 3+ launches in the last 7 days

stop_loss.description: sell when price falls by this fraction, e.g. 0.3 for -30 % (0 = none; grid 0.2, 0.3, 0.5)

take_profit.description: sell when price reaches this multiple of the entry, e.g. 2 (0 = none; grid 1.5, 2, 3, 5)

name: botsharper_simulate_bot
